note: Very quiet week across all fifteen entities; only two qualifying stories surfaced.

stories.headline: School board holds hearing on incoming superintendent's contract
stories.body: The Eastern Pulaski board held a public hearing July 27 on a proposed employment contract for its incoming superintendent, followed by a special meeting to vote on approval and on a monthly mentoring agreement with Administrator Assistance. The new hire follows Superintendent Dara Chezem's earlier resignation and the interim tenure of Dr. Gib Crimmins; the district has not yet publicly named the incoming superintendent.

stories.headline: Board approves $182 million facilities and grade-configuration plan
stories.body: The Michigan City school board approved a $182 million long-term facilities plan on July 28, converting Krueger Middle School into a grades 5-8 intermediate school, renovating Lake Hills, Pine, and Marsh elementary schools, and building a new Edgewood Elementary on its current site.
